info.name: Creo Exam Taker Backend - Full API Regression
info.description:
End-to-end functional coverage of every route exposed by the exam_taker_bc Go backend: admin auth, question bank CRUD, exam lifecycle (create/populate/activate/close), candidate registration & resume, paper retrieval, autosave answers, Piston-backed code execution (sample + custom stdin), proctoring violation strikes & auto-submit, admin grading/monitoring, and CSV export.

Run with:
  npx newman run postman/exam-taker.postman_collection.json

Override the target server with:
  npx newman run postman/exam-taker.postman_collection.json --env-var base_url=http://localhost:8080
